trajectory_summary: The call moves efficiently through verify items with a cooperative customer, but the rep never flips the bill pain, never probes the customer's stated interest in Tesla-style 'solar roofs,' and closes with a callback rather than a locked, specialist-owned appointment with full button-up mechanics. Energy neither builds nor collapses — it stays flat and procedural throughout.
outcome_dispute: The schema's call_shape allows short calls to compress beats when qualification is otherwise covered, but this call doesn't compress button_up — it omits it entirely (no hour-block, no no-driving/computer instruction, no 'is that fair' handshake, no text-follow-up promise). Because of that, and because the rep frames the next contact as 'I'll just have my specialist give you a callback' rather than confirming the appointment mechanics with the customer directly, this reads as a callback, not a fully booked appointment, even though a day and window were exchanged.
